item.title: [JGVT-3215] Balance Interface: Get Sample weighing measures from Sample Import table
item.description:
As a User, 
I want to perform weighing directly from the Sample Import Table,
So that I can capture sample weight measurements without going through the Preparations flow.

 

New story/Pre-requisite:

  • Harmonize look and feel of any GxP measurement external action
    • pH
    • weight
  • Show statuses in a collapsible panel (collapsed by default) per topic (eg "Metrology","Equipment Status" (non limitative list).
    • summarise statuses with small icons/squares: default view
    • expand metrology
    • expand equipment status
  • Enable DataTable features (compact layout, use striped rows)
    • sortable
    • searchable
    • paging
  • Maintain button functionality to capture measurement outcome (as currently is).
    •  

Business Value

  • Reduces clicks and context switching for sample workflows.
  • Improves traceability by capturing balance metadata at sample level.
  • Reuses the proven “Preparations weighing” logic for consistency and lower risk.

Scope

  • Enable Balance Interface launch from Sample Import Table rows.
  • Support the same weighing methods as Preparations (Direct, Residual Difference, Difference).
  • Commit measured/calculated values and metadata back to sample-related fields.

Out of Scope

  • Changes to balance import process in Equipment table.
  • New weighing methods.
  • Redesign of Balance (or any other instrument) Interface UI beyond what is required for sample context.
item.summary: Balance Interface: Get Sample weighing measures from Sample Import table

item.description:
As an administrator,
I want to be able to filter the audit log in the configuration admin interface to allow targeted GxP audit trail review.

1. Audit log filter

Given a Signals configuration is setup and in use for data generation
When the administrator accesses audit log in the configuration module 
Then the System shall display the audit log with the following characteristics: 

  • The filter must allow to filter on User
  • The filter must allow to filter on data range
  • The filter must allow to filter on Resource Type
  • The filter must allow to filter on Resource Name
  • The filter must allow to filter on Event

customfieldvalues.customfieldvalue:
Requirement to be revisited based upon the Audit trail stories in R3.0.0 - excel/pdf reports that currently exist - webpage that can be filtered?

1) Audit Trail filter

Given a Signals Experiment with a GxP General or GxP External Partner template
When the User requests the experiment audit trail via the external action
Then

  • the system generates the GxP Experiment Audit Trail with a filter option in the header
  • The filter will be set default on Changes: Modified, Changes: Trashed (deleted)
  • the system generates the GxP Experiment Audit Trail with the results of the default applied filters
  • the user shall be able to apply additional filters with the following characteristics: 
    • It must be possible to filter on:
      • Date
        • eg. Date: 06-DEC-2025
      • Details 
        • eg. Details: Background worksheet, Details: Preparation Master grid, Details, ...
      • Action (see JGVT-25)
        • eg. Action: Edited Table, Action: Edited Worksheet, Action: Created Worksheet, 
      • User
        • eg. User ID: tvande17
        • eg. User Name: Tamara Van den Broeck
      • Changes
        • eg. Changes: Worksheet changes, Changes: Row Added, Changes: Row Modified, ...
    • It must be possible to select multiple filter parameters
    • It must be possible to deselect the applied filter parameters including the default filters
    • The filter must refine by start typing
  • the system generates the GxP Experiment Audit Trail with the results of the additional applied or removed filters
